title: A later own-business press recovers terminal work with an existing base
steps: Exercise the real own-business HTTP doors against a scratch PostgreSQL database: change the request, leave an earlier failed or completed owned build with a live base, read it again and delete its base.
expect: A later press finds the earlier failed action instead of offering a choice that BUILD_EXISTS refuses.
A completed action remains reachable; a replaced action cannot displace its replacement.
Another account receives 404, and a deleted base no longer holds the business at its terminal action.
fence: The own-business state query preserves access to existing terminal owned work across request IDs without weakening duplicate-build or account boundaries.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=Build from my business: its own switch
tests: Build from my business: its own switch; any business found by name; researched, then one build of the customer’s own site
